# Curriculum Vitae -- Lina Al-Qahtani

Role at Wadi Lumen: Senior UI/UX Designer, since 2018.

## Summary

Seven years designing bilingual web interfaces, with a focus on long
application forms: breaking them into steps, validation messages, and
right-to-left layout for Arabic. Designed the six-step investor application
(2019) and the municipal request forms (2022).

## Skills

Figma, Adobe XD, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, responsive and right-to-left layout,
usability testing with five to eight participants per round.

## Education

BA Graphic Design, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, 2017.

## Languages

Arabic (native), English (professional).
